nodes.name: Build Speaker-Tagged Transcript
nodes.notes: Nodes 5+ start here. AssemblyAI diarization only returns generic Speaker 0/1 labels, not Agent/Customer. Heuristic: the first speaker to talk in the call is assumed to be the Agent, every other distinct speaker is folded into Customer. This is a documented assumption, not a verified mapping -- see pipeline_assumptions in the output and n8n/README.md.

nodes.name: Post-Transcription Content Check
nodes.notes: Inline deterministic post-transcription guardrail. guardrails_service's real POST /check/input only implements check_pre_transcription_input regardless of the stage field sent -- confirmed in services/guardrails_service/app/main.py, there is no post_transcription branch. Per user decision, this stays as an inline n8n check rather than calling the service a second time.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ { _pipeline_error: { stage: 'post_transcription_guardrails', error_code: 'content_guardrails_rejected', http_status: 422, message: 'Post-transcription content guardrails rejected this transcript: ' + (($json.post_transcription_check && $json.post_transcription_check.reasons) || []).join(', '), debug_error: JSON.stringify($json.post_transcription_check) } } }}

nodes.name: Gemini Information Extractor

values.content: ={{ 'TRANSCRIPT (speaker-tagged, Agent/Customer roles assigned by an n8n heuristic -- see pipeline_assumptions):\n\n' + $json.tagged_transcript }}

options.systemMessage: You are the XSight Information Extractor, one component in a larger sales-call-analysis pipeline. Your ONLY job is structured semantic extraction from the transcript given to you. You must NEVER generate coaching feedback, recommendations, a call summary judgment, or a final analysis -- other components handle that. Extract only what is explicitly present or clearly and directly implied by the transcript; never invent budgets, names, dates, or outcomes the transcript does not support. If a field cannot be determined confidently, choose the closest neutral/unclear enum value instead of guessing a specific one. Respond with ONLY one JSON object (no markdown code fences, no commentary before or after) matching exactly this shape: {"customer_intent": "high|medium|low|unclear", "main_objection": "price|timing|trust|competitor|no_need|authority|integration|security|other|none", "customer_sentiment": "positive|neutral|negative|mixed", "closing_attempt": "strong|medium|weak|none", "key_sales_events": ["short string", "..."], "call_category": "a short label such as discovery_call, pricing_negotiation, renewal, demo, or support_escalation"}.

nodes.notes: n8n node 7. Extraction only -- must never generate coaching feedback or a final analysis (see CLAUDE.md Component responsibility boundaries). Needs a real 'Gemini API - XSight' credential bound by the user before a live run (no credential exists yet in this n8n instance as of this build).

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ { _pipeline_error: { stage: 'gemini_information_extractor', error_code: 'gemini_extraction_failed', http_status: 502, message: 'Gemini Information Extractor call failed: ' + (typeof $json.error === 'string' ? $json.error : (($json.error && $json.error.message) || 'unknown error')), debug_error: JSON.stringify($json.error || $json) } } }}

nodes.name: Parse Gemini Extraction
nodes.notes: Defensively parses the Gemini node's text output (tries several known output-field shapes) and clamps every field to the enum lists services/call_signal_analyser expects, so a malformed LLM response can never break downstream schema validation.

nodes.name: AI Agent Node - Classify and Enrich

values.content:
={{ 'Transcript:
' + $('Build Speaker-Tagged Transcript').item.json.tagged_transcript + '

Gemini extraction so far:
' + JSON.stringify($json.extraction) }}

options.systemMessage: You are the n8n AI Agent Node in the XSight pipeline -- a strictly limited-role step. Your job is ONLY to: (1) classify the submission intent, (2) enrich already-extracted sales fields (normalize/add to them, do not re-extract them from scratch), (3) decide which of two downstream services (rag_service, call_signal_analyser) are relevant for this call -- default to both unless the transcript is clearly unusable, (4) note a decision_maker_present boolean if inferable from the transcript, else false. You must NEVER reason over evidence, generate coaching feedback, recommend actions, reconcile conflicting evidence, or invent information not present in the transcript or the extraction you were given -- those are other components' jobs. Respond with ONLY one JSON object, no markdown fences, no commentary, matching exactly: {"submission_intent": "short label, e.g. new_call_analysis", "decision_maker_present": true, "relevant_services": ["rag_service", "call_signal_analyser"], "enriched_call_category": "short label"}.

nodes.notes: n8n node 8 -- CLAUDE.md's limited-role n8n AI Agent Node. Must NOT reason over results, generate coaching feedback, reconcile evidence, or invent information; the prompt is scoped strictly to classify + enrich + decide relevant services. Actual downstream HTTP payload construction happens deterministically in the next Code node, not here.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ { _pipeline_error: { stage: 'ai_agent_node', error_code: 'ai_agent_enrichment_failed', http_status: 502, message: 'n8n AI Agent Node (classification/enrichment) call failed: ' + (typeof $json.error === 'string' ? $json.error : (($json.error && $json.error.message) || 'unknown error')), debug_error: JSON.stringify($json.error || $json) } } }}

nodes.name: Prepare Downstream Payloads
nodes.notes: Deterministic payload construction (not the LLM's job) -- exact request shapes per docs/api_contracts.md sections 1 and 2. sale_result is intentionally omitted from the RAG metadata since it is unknown at this point in the pipeline (Ground Truth Rules: never fabricate).

nodes.name: HTTP Request - RAG Service
nodes.notes: n8n node 9. POST /query per docs/api_contracts.md section 1. Requires RAG_SERVICE_URL env var reachable from n8n (see n8n/SETUP.md).

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ { _pipeline_error: { stage: 'rag_service', error_code: 'rag_service_unreachable', http_status: 502, message: 'RAG Service (POST /query) call failed: ' + (typeof $json.error === 'string' ? $json.error : (($json.error && $json.error.message) || 'unknown error')), debug_error: JSON.stringify($json.error || $json) } } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request - Call Signal Analyser
nodes.notes: n8n node 10. POST /analyse-call per docs/api_contracts.md section 2. Requires CALL_SIGNAL_ANALYSER_URL env var. Note: audio_features sent here are clamped into the mock service's narrow synthetic-dataset ranges (e.g. call_duration_seconds 180-900s) -- a documented limitation, not a grounded transformation, see clamped_fields upstream and n8n/README.md.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ { _pipeline_error: { stage: 'call_signal_analyser', error_code: 'call_signal_analyser_unreachable', http_status: 502, message: 'Call Signal Analyser (POST /analyse-call) call failed: ' + (typeof $json.error === 'string' ? $json.error : (($json.error && $json.error.message) || 'unknown error')), debug_error: JSON.stringify($json.error || $json) } } }}

nodes.name: Merge RAG and Signal Results
nodes.notes: n8n node 11. Waits for both the RAG Service and Call Signal Analyser branches before LangGraph runs.

nodes.name: HTTP Request - LangGraph Agent

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { question: $json.question, transcript: $json.transcript, metadata: $json.metadata, structured_extraction: $json.structured_extraction, rag_results: $json.rag_results, signal_analysis: $json.signal_analysis } }}

nodes.notes: n8n node 12. POST /agent/run per docs/api_contracts.md section 4. Requires LANGGRAPH_AGENT_URL env var. LangGraph does not call RAG/Signal Analyser itself -- n8n already fetched both and passes them in here.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ { _pipeline_error: { stage: 'langgraph_agent', error_code: 'langgraph_agent_unreachable', http_status: 502, message: 'LangGraph Agent (POST /agent/run) call failed: ' + (typeof $json.error === 'string' ? $json.error : (($json.error && $json.error.message) || 'unknown error')), debug_error: JSON.stringify($json.error || $json) } } }}

nodes.name: Gemini Final Analysis Chain

options.systemMessage: You are the XSight Gemini Final Analysis LLM Chain. You assemble the single complete final output for a sales call analysis, using ONLY the evidence given to you below: the validated transcript, the structured extraction, the AI Agent Node's enrichment, the RAG Service's retrieved historical calls (each already cited by call_id), the Call Signal Analyser's scores, and the LangGraph Agent's reasoning output. You must NEVER invent CRM facts, budgets, customer names, dates, or outcomes that are not present in what you were given. Every claim about a historical call must cite its call_id exactly as given in rag_results.citations -- never invent a call_id and never state a historical fact without one. If the evidence given to you is insufficient for a confident claim, say so plainly in the relevant field rather than guessing. Fill the 'limitations' field honestly, including any gaps you notice in the evidence (e.g. low confidence, no similar calls found, conflicting signals). Respond with ONLY one JSON object, no markdown fences, no commentary, matching EXACTLY this schema (all fields required): {"transcript": "string (the full speaker-tagged transcript, copy it through unchanged)", "call_summary": "string, 2-4 sentences, grounded only in the transcript", "customer_intent": "string", "main_objection": "string", "customer_sentiment": "positive|neutral|negative", "call_outcome": "Sale|No Sale|Follow-up Needed|Uncertain", "agent_performance_score": 3, "lead_quality_score": 3, "similar_calls": [{"call_id": "string", "agent_name": "string", "sale_result": "string", "main_objection": "string", "similarity_score": 0.8, "reason": "string"}], "coaching_feedback": ["string"], "recommended_next_action": "string", "suggested_follow_up_email": "string, a short draft email", "routing_category": "a short business category label", "confidence": 0.8, "risk_level": "Low|Medium|High", "detected_signals": ["string"], "limitations": "string, honest, may be multiple sentences"}. Do not include a guardrail_status field -- that is assigned deterministically by the workflow after you respond, not by you.

nodes.notes: n8n node 13. Assembles the complete final output JSON per CLAUDE.md's schema, grounded in the extraction + RAG + signal analysis + LangGraph reasoning only. Reuses the same 'Gemini API - XSight' credential as the two earlier Gemini nodes.

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ { _pipeline_error: { stage: 'gemini_final_analysis_chain', error_code: 'final_analysis_failed', http_status: 502, message: 'Gemini Final Analysis LLM Chain call failed: ' + (typeof $json.error === 'string' ? $json.error : (($json.error && $json.error.message) || 'unknown error')), debug_error: JSON.stringify($json.error || $json) } } }}

nodes.name: Parse Final Analysis Output
nodes.notes: Always appends the pipeline's own known limitations (post-transcription guardrails inline check, output guardrails not implemented, clamped audio features, speaker-mapping heuristic) to whatever Gemini wrote in 'limitations', so the field stays honest even if the model omits something.

nodes.name: Router - Confidence and Category
nodes.notes: n8n node 15. Implements CLAUDE.md's exact routing rule: confidence < 0.65 OR evidence_conflicts non-empty OR missing citations OR unparseable final analysis -> human_review_required. Output guardrails cannot be checked (not implemented) -- this is recorded in router_reasons, not silently ignored.

nodes.name: Build Pipeline Error Response
nodes.notes: Shared terminal error builder for every new failure branch (nodes 5-15). Fans in from Error - Content Guardrails / Error - Gemini Extraction / Error - AI Agent Enrichment / Error - RAG Service / Error - Call Signal Analyser / Error - LangGraph Agent / Error - Final Analysis, then feeds the existing 'Respond Error' node.
